# Environmental screen fixture capture notes

Captured **2026-07-14** from the listed public, unauthenticated official endpoints. Tests only read these local files and never make live requests.

- `frs_houston_rcra_excerpt.json`: EPA FRS REST, Houston Ship Channel, `(29.7355, -95.2654)`, 0.5 mi, RCRAINFO. The fixture retains three response rows verbatim from the ten-row response. URL: `https://frs-public.epa.gov/ords/frs_public2/frs_rest_services.get_facilities?latitude83=29.7355&longitude83=-95.2654&search_radius=0.5&pgm_sys_acrnm=RCRAINFO&output=JSON`
- `frs_clean_rcra.json`: EPA FRS REST, suburban/wooded Montgomery County point `(30.3, -95.5)`, 0.25 mi, RCRAINFO; the official response was an empty `FRSFacility` array. URL: `https://frs-public.epa.gov/ords/frs_public2/frs_rest_services.get_facilities?latitude83=30.3&longitude83=-95.5&search_radius=0.25&pgm_sys_acrnm=RCRAINFO&output=JSON`
- `frs_san_jacinto_sems.json`: EPA FRS REST, San Jacinto River Waste Pits point `(29.797, -95.066)`, 1 mi, SEMS. URL: `https://frs-public.epa.gov/ords/frs_public2/frs_rest_services.get_facilities?latitude83=29.797&longitude83=-95.066&search_radius=1&pgm_sys_acrnm=SEMS&output=JSON`
- `echo_houston_search.json` and `echo_houston_qid_excerpt.json`: EPA ECHO radius search at `(29.7355, -95.2654)`, 0.25 mi. The QID fixture retains two of five facility rows verbatim and omits unused response columns. ECHO required `p_radius` in addition to documented `p_sr` at capture time. URLs: `https://echodata.epa.gov/echo/echo_rest_services.get_facilities?output=JSON&p_lat=29.7355&p_long=-95.2654&p_sr=0.25&p_radius=0.25` and `https://echodata.epa.gov/echo/echo_rest_services.get_qid?output=JSON&qid=79&pageno=1`
- `nfhl_houston.json`: FEMA NFHL layer 28 point-in-polygon at `(29.7355, -95.2654)`. URL: `https://hazards.fema.gov/arcgis/rest/services/public/NFHL/MapServer/28/query?geometry=-95.2654%2C29.7355&geometryType=esriGeometryPoint&inSR=4326&spatialRel=esriSpatialRelIntersects&outFields=FLD_ZONE%2CZONE_SUBTY%2CSFHA_TF%2CSTATIC_BFE&returnGeometry=false&f=json`
- `whp_suburban_low.json`: USFS 2023 classified WHP point sample at `(30.3, -95.5)`, value 2. The endpoint in the source reference returned a migration notice, so the response was captured from the official migrated IIPP service. URL: `https://imagery.geoplatform.gov/iipp/rest/services/Fire_Aviation/USFS_EDW_RMRS_WildfireHazardPotentialClassified/ImageServer/identify`
- `usgs_design_houston_reduced.json`: field-reduced ASCE 7-22 response retaining every consumed design value. URL: `https://earthquake.usgs.gov/ws/designmaps/asce7-22.json?latitude=29.7355&longitude=-95.2654&riskCategory=II&siteClass=D&title=Pre-Phase%20I%20Screen`
- `usgs_quakes_houston.json`: exact USGS FDSN GeoJSON response for a 50 km, M2.5+ query around the Houston point. URL: `https://earthquake.usgs.gov/fdsnws/event/1/query?format=geojson&latitude=29.7355&longitude=-95.2654&maxradiuskm=50&minmagnitude=2.5`

`nfhl_unmapped.json`, `nfhl_error.json`, and `echo_empty_page.json` are deliberately API-shaped test controls, not represented as live captures.
